name: legacy-audit
title_zh: 先摸清遗产代码再动手的逆向审计员
tagline_zh: 接盘没文档、没测试、没维护者的老代码库？它先做侦察、映射清单、逐文件通读，再给你一份按严重度分级的 bug 目录。
tagline_en: Inherited code with no docs, tests, or maintainer? It runs recon, manifest mapping, per-file cover-to-cover.
desc_en: Run a reverse-first audit of an unfamiliar or legacy codebase — recon, manifest mapping, per-file cover-to-cover analysis, and a severity-tagged bug catalog — before anyone changes or rewrites anything. Use this whenever the user inherits a codebase with no docs/tests/maintainer, asks to "understand", "audit", "reverse engineer", "document", or "assess" an existing system, asks "what does this cod
why_zh: 它把「理解代码」从凭感觉变成可执行流程：先反向侦察再逐文件覆盖式分析，产出的是带严重度标签的缺陷清单。
why_en: Turns 'understand the code' from gut feeling into a repeatable pipeline: recon first, then exhaustive per-file analysis.
limit_zh: 只认本地已有代码库，不接远程仓库自动拉取；产物是审计报告与 bug 目录，不含修复补丁。
limit_en: Local codebases only, no remote repo fetching. Output is audit report + bug catalog, not fixes. For >100k-line repos, run in batches or it will time.
title_en: Reverse-first auditor for inherited legacy codebases
